name: SCALAR_SUBQUERY_SELECT_LIST
description: Scalar subquery in SELECT list returns single value

name: EXISTS_SUBQUERY_RETURNS_0_OR_1
description: EXISTS returns 1 when match, 0 when empty

name: NOT_EXISTS_SUBQUERY
description: NOT EXISTS inverts EXISTS

name: IN_SELECT_SUBQUERY_BASIC
description: IN (SELECT ...) matches set membership

name: NOT_IN_SELECT_WITH_NULL_RETURNS_NULL
description: NOT IN where the inner relation contains NULL yields NULL (three-valued)

name: ANY_OPERATOR_UNSUPPORTED
description: SQLite does NOT support `x = ANY (subquery)` — parse error

name: ALL_OPERATOR_UNSUPPORTED
description: SQLite does NOT support `x > ALL (subquery)` — parse error

name: CORRELATED_SUBQUERY_IN_WHERE
description: Correlated subquery references outer column in WHERE

name: CORRELATED_SUBQUERY_IN_SELECT_LIST
description: Correlated scalar subquery in SELECT list computes per-row aggregate

name: DERIVED_TABLE_IN_FROM_WITH_ALIAS
description: Subquery in FROM (derived table) with alias

name: MULTIPLE_DERIVED_TABLES_IN_FROM
description: Two subqueries in FROM joined explicitly

name: SCALAR_SUBQUERY_MULTI_ROW_TAKES_FIRST
description: SQLite scalar subquery returning multiple rows takes the first (no error)

name: SCALAR_SUBQUERY_MULTI_COLUMN_ERROR
description: Scalar subquery returning multiple columns is a parse error
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT (SELECT 1, 2);

name: SUBQUERY_GROUP_BY_HAVING_IN_WHERE
description: Subquery with GROUP BY+HAVING used in outer WHERE

name: CHECK_CONSTRAINT_SUBQUERY_REJECTED
description: SQLite forbids subqueries in CHECK constraints

name: SUBQUERY_LIMIT_1_AS_SCALAR
description: Subquery with LIMIT 1 used as a scalar

name: SUBQUERY_IN_INSERT_VALUES
description: INSERT ... VALUES (..., (SELECT ...)) embeds subquery

name: SUBQUERY_IN_UPDATE_SET
description: UPDATE ... SET col = (SELECT ...) updates via subquery

name: SUBQUERY_IN_DELETE_WHERE
description: DELETE ... WHERE id IN (SELECT ...)

name: NESTED_THREE_LEVEL_SUBQUERY
description: Three-level nested subquery: outer/middle/inner

name: SUBQUERY_WITH_COLLATE
description: Subquery returning a COLLATE-tagged value for case-insensitive compare

name: SUBQUERY_ORDER_BY_NO_LIMIT_SCALAR
description: Scalar subquery with ORDER BY (no LIMIT) — SQLite still honors ORDER BY for which row is taken
